definition: This dimension controls the availability and accessibility of food or resources necessary to manage the hunger clock. Variations range from scarce resources that necessitate constant exploration to abundant resources that allow for more strategic, relaxed gameplay.
exclusion_criteria: Games where resources are infinite or readily available without exploration
inclusion_criteria: Games where food is a scarce resource that requires active searching
Games that provide ample food resources to mitigate pressure from the hunger clock
title: Resource Abundance in Hunger Mechanics
